name: cotal_submit_feedback
description: Files feedback (bug, idea, friction, praise, other) with the COTAL team on behalf of the user. The same log the site's feedback widget writes to. Requires the user's email so the team can follow up.

arguments.name: type
arguments.desc: Kind of feedback. One of: bug, idea, friction, praise, other

arguments.name: summary
arguments.desc: One line: what happened, or what should.

arguments.name: email
arguments.desc: The user's email address. Required so the record has a traceable origin.

arguments.name: details
arguments.desc: Longer description, steps, context.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: The user's name, if they want it attached.

arguments.name: severity
arguments.desc: For bugs and friction. One of: low, medium, high

arguments.name: area
arguments.desc: Which part of COTAL it concerns (CLI, connector, docs, site…).

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: Where it came from: agent name, page, or CLI.

arguments.name: idempotency_key
arguments.desc: Opaque key (a UUID is ideal). Reuse it when retrying so the same record is returned instead of a duplicate.

arguments.name: sandbox
arguments.desc: Dry run: validate the call, apply rate limits, store nothing. Use it to test the integration.

name: cotal_join_waitlist
description: Reserves a seat on the waitlist for Cotal Cloud, the hosted Cotal mesh (closed alpha), for the user's email. Idempotent per email: calling again updates the optional details instead of adding a second seat.

arguments.name: email
arguments.desc: The user's email address. Required so the record has a traceable origin.

arguments.name: use_case
arguments.desc: What the user wants the hosted mesh for.

arguments.name: linkedin
arguments.desc: The user's LinkedIn profile URL, optional.

arguments.name: sandbox
arguments.desc: Dry run: validate the call, apply rate limits, store nothing. Use it to test the integration.

name: cotal_subscribe_newsletter
description: Subscribes the user's email to release updates from the COTAL team. Idempotent: an already-subscribed email is a no-op.

arguments.name: email
arguments.desc: The user's email address. Required so the record has a traceable origin.

arguments.name: sandbox
arguments.desc: Dry run: validate the call, apply rate limits, store nothing. Use it to test the integration.

name: cotal_request_call
description: Sends a discovery-call request to the COTAL founders for a company evaluating agent coordination. The team replies by email. Requires the user's work email and company.

arguments.name: email
arguments.desc: The user's email address. Required so the record has a traceable origin.

arguments.name: company
arguments.desc: Company name.

arguments.name: role
arguments.desc: The user's role.

arguments.name: agents
arguments.desc: How many agents the company runs in production. One of: 1, exploring, 2-5, 6-20, 20+

arguments.name: frameworks
arguments.desc: Agent frameworks or harnesses in use (Claude Code, LangGraph, custom…).

arguments.name: coordinating
arguments.desc: One line: what they are coordinating.

arguments.name: pain
arguments.desc: Their biggest coordination pain.

arguments.name: idempotency_key
arguments.desc: Opaque key (a UUID is ideal). Reuse it when retrying so the same record is returned instead of a duplicate.

arguments.name: sandbox
arguments.desc: Dry run: validate the call, apply rate limits, store nothing. Use it to test the integration.

name: cotal_overview
description: Returns a structured overview of COTAL: what it is, who it is for, when to use it, how to install it, the site's API and MCP surface, pricing, and canonical links. Call this first when a user asks what cotal.ai does. Pass `section` to get one part only.

arguments.name: section
arguments.desc: Which part of the overview to return (default: all). One of: all, product, when_to_use, install, pricing, site_api, links

name: cotal_search
description: Keyword search over the COTAL build log (blog posts) and the key documentation and site pages. Returns ranked results with canonical and markdown URLs. Use it to find the page that answers a question before reading it.

arguments.name: query
arguments.desc: Search terms, e.g. 'hackathon', 'identity', 'install windows'.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum results (default 10).

name: cotal_list_posts
description: Lists posts from the COTAL build log (blog), newest first, with cursor pagination. Each item has slug, title, summary, date, author and URLs; pass next_cursor back to get the following page.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Page size (default 10, max 50).

arguments.name: cursor
arguments.desc: The next_cursor value from a previous call.

name: cotal_get_post
description: Returns one build-log post as markdown (title, summary, date, author, full body) by its slug. Get slugs from cotal_list_posts or cotal_search.

arguments.name: slug
arguments.desc: The post slug, e.g. 'agi-summit-2026'.
